usage: The word 蜜蜂 (mat6 fung1) is a noun.
Use 蜜蜂 to refer specifically to bees, the insects that produce honey.
蜜蜂 can be used as the subject or object in a sentence.
When talking about multiple bees, you can add a measure word or plural marker if needed.
蜜蜂 often appears in sentences related to nature, insects, or honey production.
